newsitem.title: USA: El Al starts JFK-Fft-Tel Aviv service.
newsitem.headline: El Al starts JFK-Fft-Tel Aviv service.

text.p: El Al Israel Airlines said it has launched a Boeing 747-100 freighter service this month flying from New York's John F. Kennedy Airport to Frankfurt and then to Tel Aviv.
The freighter, carrying between 95 and 100 tonnes, will depart JFK on Saturday evenings for Frankfurt and will continue onwards to Tel Aviv on Sunday morning.
"This new service will enhance our existing Amsterdam, Luxembourg and Tel Aviv routes," Bob Liddell, USA Cargo Sales and Marketing Manager, said.
"It's really just another gateway into Europe," he added.
El Al said most cargo is expected to comprise electronics, machinery, and heavy agricultural equipment.
